title: Menu Aakhri Wari Mil Baba
body:
Tera Zakhmi Chehra Vaikh Lavaan (x2)
Firr Duniya Ton Turr Javaan Gi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Panchiyan Vaangoon Vich Pinjaray Paiy Kalleyan Takraan Maraan
Teri Yaad Ich Ro Ro Kay Baba Main Dinn Tay Raat Guzaaran
Main Jaan Diyan Teray Baaj Kaddi (x2)
Naa Baba Main Sukh Pavaan Gi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghutt Paani Aap Main Nayi Peeta Sajaad Day Zaiwar Tharay
Unna Tapp Diyan Haye Zanjeeran Nay Meray Veer Day Maas Utaaray
Udde Khoon Day Athroo Poonj Di Raye (x2)
Marr Kay Na Dard Bhulavaan Gi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lahoo Dull Da Ay Howay Dard Barraa Jurri Zakhmaan Naal Pushaa Kay
Jinna Zulfaan Nu Tu Chumm Da Say Unna Zulfaan Day Vich Khaak Ay
Jithay Shimr Tamaachay Maaray Nay (x2)
Baba Rukhsaar Vakhaavaan Gi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Sirr Howay Tereay Seenay Tay Jadon Niklay Haye Dum Baba
Tera Seena Maiton Vichar Geya Eho Kha Geya Hay Ghum Baba
Na Socheya Si Teray Baad Kaddi (x2)
Inj Raitan Vich Kurlaawan Gi.
